Recommended Gaming Resolutions:

  • 1600x900
  • 1920x1080
  • 2560x1440
The GeForce GTX 1660 Ti was a performance-segment graphics card by NVIDIA, launched on February 22nd, 2019. Built on the 12 nm process, and based on the TU116 graphics processor, in its TU116-400-A1 variant, the card supports DirectX 12. This ensures that all modern games will run on GeForce GTX 1660 Ti. The TU116 graphics processor is an average sized chip with a die area of 284 mm² and 6.60 billion transistors. It features 1536 shading units, 96 texture mapping units, and 48 ROPs. NVIDIA has paired 6 GB GDDR6 memory with the GeForce GTX 1660 Ti, which is connected using a 192-bit memory interface. The GPU is operating at a frequency of 1500 MHz, which can be boosted up to 1770 MHz, memory is running at 1500 MHz (12 Gbps effective).
Being a dual-slot card, the NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Ti draws power from 1x 8-pin power connector, with power draw rated at 120 W maximum. Display outputs include: 1x DVI, 1x HDMI 2.0, 1x DisplayPort 1.4a. GeForce GTX 1660 Ti is connected to the rest of the system using a PCI-Express 3.0 x16 interface. The card's dimensions are 229 mm x 111 mm x 35 mm, and it features a dual-slot cooling solution. Its price at launch was 279 US Dollars.
